column1: # §4.7 — Ctrl-Break aborts an in-flight long operation, returns the
# app to READY, and leaves no partial state. Per SPEC §7, Ctrl-Break
# is the canonical abort key (Ctrl-C is intentionally inert).
# Dirty A1 to a sentinel; the cancelled retrieve must NOT overwrite
# Mode returns to READY; in-memory state is unchanged (A1 still 99,
# not the on-disk 42). No journal entry was committed.
